title: Which way will the cloud stretch?
hook: Winning steps can change the shape of the next search.

knows: A score to maximise over many candidates; distance between points.
doesNotKnow: Explain selected-step covariance adaptation by generating the next candidates from the updated matrix.

objective: Explain selected-step covariance adaptation by generating the next candidates from the updated matrix.
misconception: The covariance ellipse merely follows the single best point.

claims.text: Fixed disclosed offsets A=(2,2), B=(−2,−2), C=(2,−2), D=(−2,2); no fresh random Gaussian draws. Minimize(x−y)²+.1(x+y)²: A/B1.6, C/D16; stable-ID ties select A/B.
